jade-shadows.name: Jade Shadows
jade-shadows.description: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret from his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road toward uncovering the truth… and averting an incalculable loss.

jade-shadows-constellations.name: Jade Shadows: Constellations
jade-shadows-constellations.description: When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future have come calling, and they are not alone.
